theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bh_perimeter_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ C₁ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ * ρ ^ m)) → ∀ R r : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < r → r * R < ρ₁ → ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ w in (fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g w : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C₁ * R ^ m
